abstract: OBJECTIVE: Nitric oxide is thought to play a role in the regulation of trophoblast activity. The aim of this study was to compare endothelial nitric oxide synthase expression in tissue samples taken from gestational trophoblastic diseases and placentas of normal pregnancies. METHODS: The expression of endothelial nitric oxide synthase was tested in formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissues from specimens including 8 first trimester placentas, 3 partial hydatidiform moles, 20 complete hydatidiform moles, 2 invasive moles, and 5 choriocarcinomas. The expression of antibody was scored by a semiquantitative scale to define staining intensity. RESULTS: The first trimester placentas showed moderate expression in the villous. Gestational trophoblastic diseases displayed strong to very strong endothelial nitric oxide synthase expression in the syncytiotrophoblast, villous, and proliferating mononuclear trophoblasts. CONCLUSIONS: Endothelial nitric oxide synthase expression seems to have a strong correlation with proliferation of trophoblastic cells, in gestational trophoblastic diseases and in normal pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 目的：一酸化窒素は栄養膜細胞の活性調節に関与すると考えられている。本研究は、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織と正常妊娠の胎盤で内皮型一酸化窒素合成酵素の発現を比較することを目的とした。方法：ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋組織を用い、妊娠初期胎盤8例、部分胞状奇胎3例、全胞状奇胎20例、侵入奇胎2例、絨毛癌5例を対象として、内皮型一酸化窒素合成酵素の発現を検討した。染色強度は半定量的尺度で評価した。結果：妊娠初期胎盤では絨毛に中等度の発現を認めた。妊娠性絨毛性疾患では、合胞体栄養膜細胞、絨毛、増殖性単核栄養膜細胞に強～極めて強い発現を認めた。結論：内皮型一酸化窒素合成酵素の発現は、妊娠性絨毛性疾患および正常妊娠における栄養膜細胞の増殖と強く相関すると考えられる。
